evidence.notes: Quick action describe results include local predefined default field values from metadata.
Quick action template defaults materialize local predefined field values on the template SObject.

source.content: List<QuickAction.DescribeAvailableQuickActionResult> available = QuickAction.describeAvailableActions('Account'); System.assertEquals(1, available.size()); System.assertEquals('Account.NewTask', available[0].getName()); List<QuickAction.DescribeQuickActionResult> described = QuickAction.describeQuickActions(new List<String>{'Account.NewTask'}); System.assertEquals(1, described.size()); System.assertEquals(2, described[0].getDefaultValues().size()); System.assertEquals('Name', described[0].getDefaultValues()[0].getField()); System.assertEquals('Seed Account', described[0].getDefaultValues()[0].getDefaultValue()); QuickAction.QuickActionTemplateResult template = QuickAction.retrieveQuickActionTemplate('Account.NewTask', '001000000000001'); System.assertEquals('Seed Account', (String)template.getDefaultValues().get('Name')); System.assertEquals('555-0100', (String)template.getDefaultValues().get('Phone'));
